_comment: Per-pseudo-channel HBM3E currents at 6400 MT/s, VDD 1.1 V, with static (all-0s) data, extrapolated from the HBM2 measurements along their measured data-rate trends (docs/explanation/idd-derivation.md). Standby is split over all 16 pseudo-channels of the measured HBM2 stack, and the command-driven increments over the 8 pseudo-channels the measurement loops drive: every rail = stack rail / 8 - stack IDD2N / 16. Device power is therefore the sum over all pseudo-channels, each run with its own trace (an idle trace for unused pseudo-channels). Data-pattern model fitted to the HBM2 beat-pattern measurements (relative form). IDD4R/IDD4W are the currents with static data (all knobs 0, the reference); the knobs default to 0.5 (uniform-random data). Override them with --dq-rate/--tsv-rate/--bg-rate.
